name: kmj-codebridge
description: KMJ CodeBridge connects ChatGPT Desktop to authorized KMJ projects with one-click browser OAuth and guarded project-scoped tools.

interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT Desktop to authorized KMJ projects, computers and VPS environments. The bundled local bridge opens KMJ OAuth automatically on first use, stores credentials only in the plugin data directory, and proxies only guarded CodeBridge tools.
capabilities: One-click KMJ account connection in ChatGPT Desktop
Inspect authorized projects and Git state
defaultPrompt: Connect my KMJ CodeBridge account and list my authorized devices and projects.
Use KMJ CodeBridge to inspect my authorized project and summarize its current status.

review.commerce_description: No commerce. CodeBridge accesses only projects and devices authorized by the signed-in KMJ account.

publication.release_notes: 0.3.2 switches Desktop to the bundled stdio bridge. First use opens KMJ OAuth automatically; no manual MCP URL, bearer token, or Authorize button is required.
